title: AsymEEF: Bimanual Manipulation with Asymmetric End Effectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.20557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are costly to collect and rarely reusable across end-effectors with different kinematics and action spaces. This burden grows in bimanual manipulation, where each end-effector pair may require new data. We present AsymEEF, a framework for executable cross-end-effector demonstration generation and unified bimanual policy learning. Given a small source dataset, AsymEEF transfers demonstrations to heterogeneous combinations of two-, three-, and five-fingered end-effectors without additional teleoperation. Kinematic teacher anchors provide geometric supervision, while sparse real-world X-Calib anchors correct discrepancies in grasp execution. A shared encoder maps wrist poses and actuator states to a morphology-agnostic latent space, and a morphology-conditioned decoder reconstructs target commands. translated_title: AsymEEF：基于非对称末端执行器的双臂操作
translated_abstract: 遥操作演示数据的采集成本高昂，且在具有不同运动学结构和动作空间的末端执行器之间难以复用。在双臂操作中，这一负担进一步加重，因为每一对末端执行器都可能需要采集新数据。我们提出AsymEEF，一个用于可执行的跨末端执行器演示生成与统一双臂策略学习的框架。给定一个小规模源数据集，AsymEEF能够将演示迁移到由二指、三指和五指末端执行器构成的异构组合，而无需额外的遥操作。运动学教师锚点提供几何监督，稀疏的真实世界X-Calib锚点则校正抓取执行中的偏差。共享编码器将手腕姿态和执行器状态映射到一个与形态无关的潜在空间，由形态条件化解码器重建目标命令。生成的轨迹经过回放过滤以保证任务级的可执行性。该表示还支持……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AsymEEF框架无需额外遥操作，即可将小规模演示数据迁移至二指、三指、五指等异构非对称末端执行器组合，并通过形态无关的潜在空间表示实现统一的双臂操作策略学习。
en_tdlr: AsymEEF transfers a small source dataset of demonstrations to heterogeneous asymmetric end-effector pairs (2-, 3-, and 5-fingered) without additional teleoperation, and learns unified bimanual manipulation policies through a morphology-agnostic latent representation with kinematic anchors and replay filtering.
